mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drug ( drug_code, drug_name, generic_name, category, specification, unit, manufacturer, approval_number, purchase_price, sale_price, low_stock_threshold, enabled, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) VALUES ( #{drugCode}, #{drugName}, #{genericName}, #{category}, #{specification}, #{unit}, #{manufacturer}, #{approvalNumber}, #{purchasePrice}, #{salePrice}, #{lowStockThreshold}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{deleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE drug SET drug_name = #{drugName}, generic_name = #{genericName}, category = #{category}, specification = #{specification}, unit = #{unit}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, approval_number = #{approvalNumber}, purchase_price = #{purchasePrice}, sale_price = #{salePrice}, low_stock_threshold = #{lowStockThreshold}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
